commission: D-001 Condition 1 DR-004: commission the missing §3.1-item-to-supplier binding instrument. D-036: Lane R starts now, including this instrument (one start instruction).
authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the binding table that maps freeze §3.1's eight mandatory items to named suppliers (path + selector + sha256) or to an explicit UNBOUND state. Its checker fails when a bound supplier file is missing, a BOUND item has no supplier key, its selector disappears, or its exact byte digest moves (DIGEST-MOVED). That is the detection gap D-001 named: a supersession can silently drop a Phase-1A supplier and no checker will say so. This artifact is not the Phase-1A packet, not SATISFIED evidence, and not owner recording of any Route B disposition.
theErrorThisExistsToPrevent: Conflating 'a successor still exists' with 'the item's supplier selector still exists'. Measured precedent: retention-tiers.v24 carried partB_purgeSemantics.distinction as item 4's primary supplier; v28, the applied head, does not carry partB_purgeSemantics at all. File 08 recorded that drop after the fact. This instrument makes that class of drop a checker failure.

failsWhen: A BOUND item's supplier path is missing
A BOUND item has no supplier key
A BOUND item's selector does not resolve on those bytes
A BOUND item's supplier digest does not match the digest this checker measures at run time — recorded as DIGEST-MOVED, not as coverage
The eight verbatim item texts no longer match freeze §3.1 at the pinned freeze digest; if the freeze moved, the checker reports ENVIRONMENT and fails closed rather than silently following
doesNotFailWhen: A successor of a bound file exists beside it
File 08 status cells have not changed

A BOUND item's head resolves but supplies only part of what its freeze item names — the checker tests selector presence, not coverage of the item text. That judgement is the reviewer's and the owners'

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not mark DR-004 or DR-002 SATISFIED.
Does not substitute for the Route B dispositions on DR-003/005/008.
Does not apply product-dispositions.v1 or treat CD-RT-5 as Phase-1A.
Does not bind evaluation-proof.v8 as item 1; verdict claims are missing.
remeasurementClause: If a cited file moves, re-measure. A moved freeze is ENVIRONMENT; the checker fails closed until this table is re-pinned by a successor.
